claim.claim-text: 2. The device for treating truncal and/or collateral varicose veins according to claim 1, characterized in that there is a distance (b) comprised between 0.4 cm and 1.1 cm between the hole (6) closest to the distal end (20) of the conduct (2) and said distal end (20).

3. The device for treating truncal and/or collateral varicose veins (1) according to claim 1, characterized in that that the “n” holes (6) are separated (a) at a distance comprised between 0.15 mm and 0.55 mm.
4. The device for treating truncal and/or collateral varicose veins (1) according to claim 1, characterized in that the diameter of the hole (6) will be comprised between 0.05 mm and 0.5 mm.

6. The physio-chemical method for use with the device for treating varicose veins according to claim 5, wherein step b) is characterized in that a mixture of 3 cc to 5 cc of sclerosant substance is prepared with 1.5 cc to 3 cc of air, in order to produce 8 cc to 10 cc of medication (51).

7. The physio-chemical method for use with the device for treating varicose veins according to claim 5, wherein step c) is characterized in that between 0.2 and 0.5 cc of medication (51) are injected and the laser (31) is fired continuously at between 1.5 and 5 Watts, for a time period of between 3 and 4 seconds.

8. The physio-chemical method for use with the device for treating varicose veins according to claim 5, wherein step c) is characterized in that between 0.2 and 0.5 cc of medication (51) are injected and the laser (31) is fired in pulses at 60 ms to 100 ms for a time period of between 3 to 4 seconds at 4 Watts, the administration of the pulses depending on the type of laser.
